background.value: Red (merah) solid background -- shown as the approved-photo example in the official guide

file_spec.value: File format JPEG/JPG/PNG, in color. Minimum 400x600px. Maximum file size 2MB. Photo layout/position must be properly composed (not too close, not too far).

head_height.value: Top of head (including hair) to bottom of chin must occupy 50%-60% of total image height; eye height (measured from the bottom of the image to eye level) must also be 50%-60% of image height. Applied to DB's own listed 4x6cm print size, this ratio implies an approximate head height of 3.0-3.6cm.

expression_restriction.value: Neutral expression required -- 'expression face photo' (smiling/exaggerated expression) is explicitly listed as an unrecommended photo, alongside blurry photos and non-face-only photos

glasses_policy.value: Glasses and contact lenses (including colored or vision-altering lenses) are not permitted -- they may cause reflections/shadows that interfere with biometric identification

face_visibility.value: Hair must not cover the ears or eyes; long hair should be tucked behind the ears/shoulders

clothing_restriction.value: Neat clothing with a collar is required

expression.en: A neutral expression is required; smiling or exaggerated expressions are explicitly listed as unrecommended.
expression.ko: 중립적인 표정이 필수이며, 미소나 과도한 표정은 비권장 사항으로 명시되어 있다.
expression.ja: 中立的な表情が必須であり、笑顔や過度な表情は非推奨として明記されている。

glasses.en: Glasses and contact lenses (including colored or vision-altering lenses) are not permitted -- they may cause reflections or shadows that interfere with biometric identification.
glasses.ko: 안경 및 콘택트렌즈(컬러 렌즈·도수 변경 렌즈 포함) 착용이 금지된다 -- 생체인식 식별을 방해하는 반사나 그림자를 유발할 수 있다.
glasses.ja: 眼鏡およびコンタクトレンズ(カラーレンズ・度数変更レンズを含む)の着用は禁止 -- 生体認証の識別を妨げる反射や影を生じる可能性がある。

face_visibility.en: Hair must not cover the ears or eyes; long hair should be tucked behind the ears and shoulders.
face_visibility.ko: 머리카락이 귀나 눈을 가려서는 안 되며, 긴 머리는 귀와 어깨 뒤로 넘겨야 한다.
face_visibility.ja: 髪の毛で耳や目を覆ってはならず、長い髪は耳と肩の後ろにまとめること。

clothing.en: Neat clothing with a collar is required.
clothing.ko: 카라(옷깃)가 있는 단정한 의상을 착용해야 한다.
clothing.ja: 襟付きのきちんとした服装を着用すること。

db_conflicts.research_value: ~3.0-3.6cm (computed from the official 50%-60%-of-image-height ratio applied to DB's own listed 4x6cm print size)

cross_verification.note_en: Primary source is an official Directorate General of Immigration (imigrasi.go.id) PDF titled 'Syarat Foto' (Photo Requirements), fetched and read directly (not via search synthesis) -- it visually shows a RED background in the approved-photo example, matching DB exactly (no conflict on background). It states composition ratios rather than a fixed cm head-height; applying those ratios to DB's own stated 4x6cm print size yields ~3.0-3.6cm, which only marginally overlaps DB's stated 2.5-3.1cm, so it is logged as a conflict. Glasses/hair/clothing rules are corroborated by multiple official imigrasi.go.id regional-office subdomains (banggai, malang, balikpapan) that appeared directly in search results (not third-party vendor sites). A separately-seen general claim that passport applicants should 'avoid white clothing because the background is white' was deliberately excluded because it contradicts the directly-observed red background and appears to describe a different photo context (likely visa/white-background applications).
